Resolves #99

Docs class views now show independently toggleable mixin providers and their supplied members. Repeated providers appear once. Direct mixins start enabled; ancestors and ancestor-only mixins retain the default-off behavior from #4528. Member badges and source links identify the mixin while the selected class remains the view's target.

Evidence: L3 (freshly generated Docs data, native browser clicks, Neural Link worker-state checks, source navigation and inspected screenshot) → L3 required for both visible Docs behaviors. No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| Original request | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1: Show mixins in the hierarchy so users can uncheck them | `HierarchyTreeList.spec.mjs` covers provider deduplication, defaults, toggles and all-sources-off; `DocsMixinsNL.spec.mjs` clicks the real Store/Observable toggle. |
| AC-2: List their methods in the class view | The same specs cover supplied members, selected-source method/config precedence, visibility filters, provenance and opening Observable's source. |

## Deltas from ticket

The existing generated `mixes` and `neoClassName` metadata supplies the feature. The selected class no longer depends on the last hierarchy row, and rendering no longer mutates source names. Runtime-excluded mixin members are removed before collision resolution. The hierarchy uses its checkbox filter state without separate record selection, avoiding Store-only key APIs on its plain collection. The [intake contract](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/99#issuecomment-6655852834) retains the runtime and live-click probes behind these choices.

Generated `meta.srcPath` now supplies both navigation URLs and member source labels relative to the project root. This removes checkout-name matching, which made the source link request `neo/engine/src/core/Observable.mjs` in CI's nested checkout.

## Test Evidence

The new browser spec generates the canonical Docs payloads, opens Store through API navigation, toggles Observable off/on, filters to `fire`, and opens its real source through the rendered link. Its screenshot was inspected. All retained unit and browser coverage runs in CI; the Neural Link spec uses the existing Brain-backed fixture.

Local validation: 14 focused Docs/generator tests and the browser spec pass. The generator regression runs real parsing in nested and arbitrarily named Engine roots plus a consumer app; the nested case reproduced CI's wrong URL before the repair. Installed-package discovery is outside this receipt: the existing parser excludes `node_modules`, so the consumer case asserts the local app only.

`agent-preflight` is not hosted in this Engine checkout; PR-body, source hooks, diff and file-size checks run directly.

## Post-Merge Validation

None required beyond the verified behavior.

Related: #15000, #4528

Authored by Sophie (GPT-6 Astra, ultra, Codex Desktop). Session 2127005d-d2e7-46c1-a8f5-9e1575bc6fae.
